knowledgePoints.title: Unit 1 常用句型
knowledgePoints.content: 把句型读熟，再替换关键词造句。注意 be 动词要和主语一致（I 用 am，单数用 is，复数用 are）。

knowledgePoints.content: 把句型读熟，再替换关键词造句。注意 be 动词要和主语一致（I 用 am，单数用 is，复数用 are）。

knowledgePoints.title: be 动词与人称搭配
knowledgePoints.content: I 用 am；he / she / it 和单数名词用 is；you / we / they 和复数名词用 are。

knowledgePoints.title: 句型转换：一般疑问句与单复数互换
knowledgePoints.content:
含 be 动词的句子变一般疑问句：把 am / is / are 提到句首，第一人称 my 要改成第二人称 your。
复数句变单数句：these / those → this / that，are → is，名词去 -s，并补上冠词 a / an。

knowledgePoints.title: 短文阅读：先在文中找关键词
knowledgePoints.content:
做阅读题不要凭印象：先读题干圈出关键词（地点、数量、爱好），再回短文里找同一句话。
注意 on the second floor（在二楼）与 forty（四十）这类数字、楼层信息，是四年级最常考的两类细节。

units.desc: 学校场所与楼层，会用 Is this…? / Where is…? 问位置。

topics.title: 常用句型（5 题）
topics.desc: 学校场所与楼层，会用 Is this…? / Where is…? 问位置。

exercises.question:
【句型】图书馆在二楼。
The library is on the ____ floor.
exercises.explanation: 图书馆在二楼。 →「The library is on the second floor.」

exercises.question:
【句型】让我们去操场吧。
Let's go to the ____ .
exercises.explanation: 让我们去操场吧。 →「Let's go to the playground .」

exercises.question:
【句型】美术室在音乐室旁边。
The art room is ____ to the music room.
exercises.explanation: 美术室在音乐室旁边。 →「The art room is next to the music room.」

exercises.question:
【句型】你的作业做完了吗？
Did you finish your ____ ?
exercises.explanation: 你的作业做完了吗？ →「Did you finish your homework ?」

exercises.question:
【句型】我们班有四十名学生。
There are ____ students in our class.
exercises.explanation: 我们班有四十名学生。 →「There are forty students in our class.」

exercises.question: 【单词默写】上床睡觉 → （　）
exercises.explanation: 上床睡觉 → go to bed

topics.title: 常用句型（5 题）
topics.desc: 时间与日常作息，会用 What time is it? / It's time for… 表达。

exercises.question:
【句型】现在几点了？
What ____ is it now?
exercises.explanation: 现在几点了？ →「What time is it now?」

exercises.question:
【句型】该吃早饭了。
It's time for ____ .
exercises.explanation: 该吃早饭了。 →「It's time for breakfast .」

exercises.question:
【句型】我六点起床。
I ____ up at six o'clock.
exercises.explanation: 我六点起床。 →「I get up at six o'clock.」

exercises.question:
【句型】我们七点去上学。
We go to ____ at seven o'clock.
exercises.explanation: 我们七点去上学。 →「We go to school at seven o'clock.」

exercises.question:
【句型】该上床睡觉了。
It's time to go to ____ .
exercises.explanation: 该上床睡觉了。 →「It's time to go to bed .」

exercises.question:

exercises.explanation: 农场上有十只母鸡。 →「There are ten hens on the farm.」

exercises.question:

exercises.question:

units.name: 语法专项
units.title: 语法专项 · be 动词、单复数与疑问句
units.desc: 把四下最常错的语法点单独练一遍：be 动词搭配、名词复数、一般疑问句。

exercises.question:
【句型】【be 动词】我是一名学生。
I ____ a student.
exercises.explanation: I 后面用 am：I am a student.

exercises.question:
【句型】【be 动词】她是我的老师。
She ____ my teacher.
exercises.explanation: she 是第三人称单数，用 is。

exercises.question:
【句型】【be 动词】他们是我的朋友。
They ____ my friends.

【句型】【指示代词】这些是我的书。
____ are my books.
exercises.explanation: 指近处的复数用 These，句首大写。

exercises.question:
【句型】【名词复数】一个西红柿，两个西红柿
one tomato, two ____
exercises.explanation: 以 o 结尾的 tomato 变复数加 -es。

exercises.question:
【句型】【一般疑问句】这是你的钢笔吗？
____ this your pen?
exercises.explanation: 含 be 动词的句子变一般疑问句，把 is 提到句首。

units.name: 拔高 · 句型转换与阅读
units.title: 拔高 · 句型转换与阅读理解
units.desc: 四下内容的提高档：句型转换、情景应答、短文阅读。答案唯一，不做开放题。

modules.title: 句型转换：一般疑问句与单复数互换

exercises.question: 【句型转换】This is my skirt.（改为一般疑问句）
exercises.explanation: 把 is 提到句首；问别人时 my 要改成 your，所以是 Is this your skirt?

exercises.question: 【句型转换】These are tomatoes.（改为单数句）
exercises.explanation: these → this，are → is，tomatoes 去 -es 并补冠词：This is a tomato.

exercises.question: 【句型转换】They're cows.（改为一般疑问句）
exercises.explanation: 含 be 动词的句子，把 are 提到 they 前面即可。

exercises.question: 【情景应答】别人问 How much is it? 你应该回答：
exercises.explanation: 问的是 it（单数），所以答语也用 it；金额用 It's … yuan 表达。

modules.title: 短文阅读：先在文中找关键词

exercises.question:
【短文】Hello! I'm Amy. I'm from the UK. This is my school. It's big and beautiful. The library is on the second floor. There are forty classrooms in my school. I like the playground best. After school, I often play games there with my friends.

【阅读】Where is the library?
exercises.explanation: 短文原句：The library is on the second floor.

exercises.question:
【短文】Hello! I'm Amy. I'm from the UK. This is my school. It's big and beautiful. The library is on the second floor. There are forty classrooms in my school. I like the playground best. After school, I often play games there with my friends.

【阅读】How many classrooms are there in Amy's school?
exercises.explanation: 短文原句：There are forty classrooms in my school. 注意 forty（四十）与 fourteen（十四）别混。

exercises.question:
【短文】Hello! I'm Amy. I'm from the UK. This is my school. It's big and beautiful. The library is on the second floor. There are forty classrooms in my school. I like the playground best. After school, I often play games there with my friends.

【阅读】Amy likes the ____ best.
exercises.explanation: 短文原句：I like the playground best.

exercises.question:
【短文】Hello! I'm Amy. I'm from the UK. This is my school. It's big and beautiful. The library is on the second floor. There are forty classrooms in my school. I like the playground best. After school, I often play games there with my friends.

【阅读】Amy often plays games ____ after school.
exercises.explanation: 短文说 I like the playground best. After school, I often play games there…，there 指的就是操场。
